sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Add file from suspicious location to autostart registry
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Add file from suspicious location to autostart registry

match_context.values: @{CommandLine=cmd.exe /c reg add HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run /v MicroMedia /t REG_SZ /d C:\Users\<USER>\AppData\Local\Temp\MicroMedia\MediaCenter.exe; Image=cmd.exe; EventID=1}

sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects the execution of a Windows system binary that is usually located in the system folder from an uncommon location.
sigma_analysis_results.rule_author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Patrick Bareiss, Anton Kutepov, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
